verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM ships AI features (Copilot, AI email drafting), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions AI model training, data-use policy, or any opt-out. The admin controls over who can use Copilot, Strict mode, and deletion blocking are adjacent permission switches, not protection against training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
